Context: The ORU shall indicate-

## The ORU shall indicate-  
- (i) the 'Total procurement through GeM portal' made by him/her
- during the period of report,
- (ii) specifying the % of procurement through GeM portal,
- (iii)
- the procurements made outside GeM and the reasons therefor, and
- steps taken for promotion of GeM in the Ministry/ Department/
- (iv) Division/ Section.
